desc: An AMULET made from a forked piece of DEER ANTLER, hung on a small upright wooden peg with its braided leather cord and three bone beads. an ancient sacred relic of the first ten humans, small, weathered and very old, seen from the high three-quarter top-down game camera, standing upright on its own (no stand, no table, no ground) as it would sit on a small offering tray.
